subject: BUG: Fix off by one in StableGraph::node_bound
summary: `StableGraph::node_bound` used `rposition(...).unwrap_or(0) + 1`, which collapses to `1` on an empty graph and is off by one on dense graphs; the fix uses `next_back().map_or(0, |i| i.index() + 1)`.

subject: Fix bug in order of iterative dfs
summary: `Dfs::move_to` pre-visited the new start node while `next` dropped the pop-time `discovered.visit(node)` gate; reusing a Dfs via `move_to` after a full traversal re-emitted the already-discovered start node. The fix keeps the visit check at pop-time and no longer pre-visits.

subject: FIX: Include self loops in incoming edges
summary: Directed GraphMap self-loops have only an Outgoing adjacency entry, so filtering solely by direction incorrectly omits them from neighbors_directed(node, Incoming). The fix records the starting node and accepts neighbors matching either the requested direction or the starting node. Reversing the iterator filter restores the faulty behavior. The fix adds neighbors_incoming_includes_self_loops in tests/graphmap.rs, which expects Some(()) for the self-loop. No tests were executed.

subject: Fix Floyd-Warshall algorithm behavior toward undirected graphs (#487)
summary: Floyd-Warshall initialized each undirected edge in only its stored source-to-target direction, producing asymmetric and incorrect shortest-path distances. The fix also initializes the reverse direction for undirected graphs. The regression test added by this commit expects distance 3 from a to c through b; reversing the initialization fix should produce 4 instead. Both proposed regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No tests were executed.

subject: Fix various bugs in matrix graph (#427)
summary: Growing a directed MatrixGraph discards existing edges because the parent implementation swaps local slice references instead of their contents, then replaces the adjacency vector with the empty new vector. The fix moves actual elements within the expanded vector, processing rows backwards and handling overlapping slices safely. The regression test added by this commit checks that existing edges survive growth from capacity 4 to 8. This reversal isolates the edge-preservation correction; no tests were executed.

subject: graph: Fix bug in WalkEdges::next_neighbor
summary: WalkEdges::next_neighbor returned the starting endpoint instead of the neighboring endpoint: the source for outgoing walks and the target for incoming walks. The fix selects the opposite endpoint using 1 - self.direction as usize. The fix-added walk_edges test in tests/ograph.rs detects the bug because its outgoing traversal computes zero edge weights instead of target-minus-source differences. No builds or tests were run.

subject: fix: Ford Fulkerson sometimes Panics on StableGraphs (#793)
summary: Ford-Fulkerson allocated its flow vector using edge_count() but indexed it by edge IDs. Removing edges from a StableGraph leaves gaps, so remaining edge IDs can exceed the vector bounds and cause a panic. Using edge_bound() allocates space for every valid edge index. The fix adds test_ford_fulkerson_stable_graphs in tests/ford_fulkerson.rs, gated by the default-enabled stable_graph feature. No tests were executed.

subject: feat: Fix self-loop bug in all_simple_paths and enable multiple targets (#865)
summary: When source and target are identical, all_simple_paths can incorrectly yield cycles that repeat the source node. The fix rejects visited neighbors before checking for the target and excludes visited targets during cutoff lookahead. The selected test was added by this fix and asserts that paths from node 1 back to itself in an undirected path graph are empty. This reversal restores only the original single-target implementation logic. No tests were executed.
